layout.assumptions: Illustrative unmeasured geometry; inner lane centre radius 0.60 m; both lanes follow the clockwise centreline order. Vehicle and camera values are provisional, not measured calibration. Symmetric front/rear overhang is assumed; the rear-axle initial pose places the front bumper on the start line. All courses share 4.5 by 3 m bounds, the start pose and obstacle coordinates; straight lengths change with the corner radius. R0.75 and R0.80 parking bays are shifted 0.10 m north to stay inside the infield; the parking entrance lies behind the camera at the initial pose. Obstacle placement and parking manoeuvres are not physically validated; no autonomous parking planner is added.
